_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Vayikra 11, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And God spoke to Moses and Aaron, and said to them:
translations.2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and say to them: This is the animal which it is permitted that you eat, from all the beasts that walk upon the earth:
translations.3: every one that is hoofed with a hoof, and whose hooves are divided in a division, and that brings up cud, among the beasts — eat it.
translations.4: But this you shall not eat, from those that bring up cud and those that are divided of hoof: the camel — for it brings up cud yet is not hoofed with a hoof; it is impure for you.
translations.5: And the hyrax — for it brings up cud yet is not hoofed with a hoof; it is impure for you.
translations.6: And the hare — for it brings up cud, yet it is not hoofed; it is impure for you.
translations.7: And the swine — for it is hoofed with a hoof, and its hoof is divided in a division, yet it is one that does not chew cud; it is impure for you.
translations.8: Of their flesh you shall not eat, and to their carcasses you shall not approach; thus they are impure for you.
translations.9: This is what it is permitted that you eat from all that is in the water: everything that has fins and scales in the water, in the seas and the wadis — eat it.
translations.10: But everything that has no fins and scales, in the seas and the wadis, from all the creeping things of the water, and all the animals that are in the water — it is an abomination for you.
translations.11: Their being abominations for you — of their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall treat as abominations.
translations.12: Thus everything that has no fins and scales in the water — it is an abomination for you.
translations.13: And these are what you shall treat as abominations from the birds — they shall not be eaten, for they are abominations: the vulture, and the eagle, and the 'anqah.
translations.14: And the kite, and the buzzard according to its kinds.
translations.15: And all the ravens according to their kinds.
translations.16: And the ostrich, and the swift and the 'saf', and the hawk according to its kinds.
translations.17: And the owl, and the cormorant, and the eagle-owl.
translations.18: And the falcon, and the pelican, and the vulture.
translations.19: And the saker and the parrot according to its kinds, and the hoopoe and the bat.
translations.20: And all the creeping things of the birds that walk on four — it is an abomination for you.
translations.21: But this is what it is permitted that you eat from all the creeping things of the birds that walk on four: whatever has two jumping-legs above its feet, with which to leap upon the earth.
translations.22: These are what you may eat from them: the locust and its kinds, and the duba and its kinds, and the harjal and its kinds, and the grasshopper and its kinds.
translations.23: And the rest of the creeping things of the birds that have four legs — it is an abomination for you.
translations.24: And by these you shall become impure: every one who approaches their carcasses shall wash his garments and be impure until the setting.
translations.25: And every one who carries from their carcasses shall wash his garments and be impure until the setting.
translations.26: From all the beasts that are hoofed with a hoof, yet division is not in them as divided, and cud-chewing is not in them as bringing up — they are impure for you; every one who approaches them shall be impure.
translations.27: And every one that walks on its paws, from all the wild creatures that walk on four — it is impure for you; every one who approaches their carcasses shall be impure until the setting.
translations.28: And whoever carries from their carcasses shall wash his garments and be impure until the setting. Thus they are impurities for you.
translations.29: And this is what is impure for you from the creeping things that creep upon the earth: the mole, and the mouse, and the spiny lizard according to its kinds.
translations.30: And the monitor lizard, and the gecko, and the chameleon, and the agama, and the skink.
translations.31: These are the impure for you from all the creeping things; every one who approaches them at the time of their death shall be impure until the setting.
translations.32: And everything upon which any of them falls after their death shall be impure — from any vessel of wood, or cloth, or leather, or sacking; and every vessel with which work is done shall be brought into the water, and shall be impure until the setting, and then it shall be pure.
translations.33: And any earthen vessel into which anything of them falls — everything within it shall be impure, and it itself you shall break.
translations.34: From all food that is eaten, if water enters it, it shall be impure; and all drink that is drunk, in any vessel, shall be impure.
translations.35: And everything upon which any of their carcasses falls shall be impure — whether an oven or a stove, demolish them both, for they are impure; and thus they are impurities for you.
translations.36: But a spring and a well, and a gathering of water, shall remain pure; yet whoever approaches their carcasses in it shall be impure.
translations.37: And if any of their carcasses falls upon any of the vegetation and grain that is sown, it is pure.
translations.38: But if water has been placed upon it and then any of their carcasses falls upon it, it is impure for you.
translations.39: And when there dies from the animals which it is permitted for you to eat, whoever approaches its carcass shall be impure until the setting.
translations.40: And whoever eats from it shall wash his garments and be impure until the setting; and whoever carries from it shall wash his garments and be impure until the setting.
translations.41: And all the creeping things that creep upon the earth — it is an abomination, it shall not be eaten.
translations.42: Every one that walks on its belly, and every one that walks on four, and whatever has many legs, from all the creeping things that creep upon the earth — do not eat them, for they are abominations.
translations.43: And do not make your souls abominable with anything of the creeping things that creep, and do not defile yourselves with them, lest you disobey Me thereby.
translations.44: For I am God your Lord — sanctify yourselves and be holy, for I am holy; and do not defile your souls with anything of the creeping things that creep upon the earth.
translations.45: For I am God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt, to be your God — so be holy, for I am the Holy One.
translations.46: This is the law of the beasts and the birds, and all the living souls that creep in the water, and the rest of the souls that creep upon the earth:
translations.47: that you separate between the impure and the pure, and between the animal that may be eaten and that which may not be eaten."
